headline: Small short-period stuff today — the good SE angle lands Wednesday.
today: Around 2ft of short-period SSW at a fair angle, cross-off at dawn then cross-on SE in the afternoon. Longboard the morning if you're local, but nothing here justifies the drive today. Water's a chilly 71.

daysToWatch.note: Best day here: 2.2-2.8ft SE at a prime angle, total to 3.8ft, with ENE cross-off at dawn cleaning it up. Early session before the ESE wind swings cross. Fish or shortboard.
Prime E angle and clean with 15-18mph NNE offshore, but only 1.5-1.7ft short period — small and workable, log territory. Clean but not big.
